choice: ubuntu changes job plus a job-level if on macos
why: a skipped check run is not run for ci_status and passes a GitHub required check; a path-filtered workflow would leave a required check pending forever

choice: changes steps run only on pull_request; on push they skip, the job succeeds, and macos runs through the event_name branch
why: the plan ran the diff on every event, but push events carry no pull_request.base.sha so the diff would fail and turn main red

choice: ci.yml, lib/job_run.py, lib/remote.py, tests/test_process_discovery.py, requirements.txt, requirements-dev.txt; exact-line match
why: the ticket's list plus dependency files; hot shared imports stay out so macos does not run on most PRs, and push-to-main still covers them

choice: set -euo pipefail with the diff captured in a variable
why: a missing base commit fails the changes job (red run) instead of silently skipping macos

choice: tests/test_ci_workflow.py runs the real step script against real git diffs and parses ci.yml
why: 13 cases failed on the old ci.yml (no changes job) and pass now

choice: git diff --no-renames in the changes step
why: f-1: with rename detection --name-only lists only the destination, so renaming a macOS path away skipped macos; --no-renames lists the deleted source too. test (2/3) red on ef29ad5 was test_dashboard_ticket_detail.py (CDP "Inspected target navigated or closed"), which this PR does not touch
